column1: # Lane's own corrections to the official ESCO -> O*NET-SOC crosswalk (not a downloaded source).
# Each row replaces all of that ESCO occupation's official links. Replacement codes must be rated in the O*NET release.

column5: rationale

Title Examiners search real-estate records; M&A deal work is investment banking. O*NET files M&A titles under 13-2051.00, which has no ratings, so this uses rated 41-3031.00 (O*NET job title 'Investment Banker'; 'provide financial services to businesses') plus 13-2099.01 ('valuation of financial instruments'), which is the rated link its sibling corporate investment banker already has.

Brokerage Clerks write orders and keep records, which is clerical work. O*NET lists 'Securities Underwriter' under 13-2051.00, which has no ratings. The rated 41-3031.00 ('Buy and sell securities ... in investment and trading firms'; job title 'Investment Banker') matches ESCO's 'establish the price and buy and sell them to other investors'.
Two-thirds of the weight sits on technician and aide codes. O*NET 29-1051.00 Pharmacists has the reported titles 'Registered Pharmacist' and 'Community Pharmacist'.
O*NET lists 'Hospital Pharmacist' under 29-1051.00 Pharmacists. The technician and aide links misrepresent a licensed pharmacist.
O*NET lists 'Industrial Pharmacist' under 29-1051.00 Pharmacists. The technician and aide links misrepresent a pharmacist.
Specialist pharmacists are pharmacists, and O*NET files 'Clinical Pharmacist' and 'Radiopharmacist' under 29-1051.00. The technician and aide links misrepresent the job.

An assistant-level job should not carry a third of its weight on Pharmacists. O*NET files 'Pharmacy Assistant' under 31-9095.00 Pharmacy Aides. This keeps the technician and aide links and drops the pharmacist link.

O*NET 29-2052.00 Pharmacy Technicians has the titles 'Pharmacy Technician (Pharm Tech)' and 'Certified Pharmacy Technician'. Without an override this occupation falls back to the ISCO 2262 pharmacist group.

Rehabilitation Counselors serve people coping with disability or illness, and Compensation/Benefits is a pay-analysis job. O*NET 13-1071.00 Human Resources Specialists holds 'Job Placement Specialist', 'Employment Interviewer' and 'Placement Officer', which match 'match job seekers with advertised job vacancies'.

Online Merchants run e-commerce retail (buying, inventory, shipping), which has nothing to do with community management. O*NET files 'Social Media Specialist' under both 13-1161.01 and 13-1161.00 ('Content Strategist'). This keeps the defensible 13-1161.01 link.

O*NET files 'Web Content Manager', 'Website Content Manager' and 'Web Content Coordinator' under 15-1299.01. Web Developers write code, which ESCO's curate/create-content role does not do, so this drops that half of the weight.

New Accounts Clerks interview people who want to open bank accounts, a clerical job. O*NET files 'Estate Trustee' under 13-2052.00 Personal Financial Advisors, which matches administering trusts and setting investment goals.
This has the same clerk misrepresentation as the trust officer. 'Financial Planner' and 'Certified Financial Planner (CFP)' are reported titles of O*NET 13-2052.00.
Half the weight sits on grounds-maintenance labour, and 17-1011.00 explicitly excludes landscape architects. 'Landscape Architect' is a reported title of O*NET 17-1012.00 Landscape Architects.
O*NET lists 'Legal Consultant' and 'Foreign Legal Consultant' under 23-1011.00 Lawyers. ESCO says these consultants advise clients outside courtrooms, so the adjudicator link misrepresents the job.
'Lawyer' is a reported title of O*NET 23-1011.00. Two-thirds of the weight sits on judges and on paralegals, a support role, which misrepresents practising lawyers.
Corporate lawyers are lawyers (O*NET 23-1011.00, 'Lawyer'). Half the weight sits on the paralegal support role, which misrepresents the job.

Bank tellers receive and pay out cash. O*NET 11-1011.00 Chief Executives ('provide overall direction of ... public sector organizations'; titles 'Bank President', 'President') is the top-executive code O*NET uses for heads of public bodies (ISCO 1112).

Epidemiologists are research scientists and Health Education Specialists run health-promotion programmes. O*NET files 'Environmental Health Inspector' and 'Public Health Inspector' under 19-5011.00 and 'Health Inspector' under 13-1041.01, so this keeps that official link.

Only a fifth of the weight sits on Paramedics. The rest goes to physicians, anaesthesiologist assistants, respiratory therapists and orderlies. O*NET 29-2043.00 Paramedics ('Critical Care Paramedic', 'Firefighter Paramedic') is the exact job.
A driver who supports paramedics should not be profiled as an emergency physician. O*NET 53-3011.00 has the reported titles 'Ambulance Driver', 'EMS Driver' and 'Emergency Vehicle Operator'.

Gambling Dealers run casino table games. The ESCO job runs the tote (pari-mutuel) operation and equipment. O*NET files 'Mutuel Machine Operator' and 'Pari Mutuel Clerk' under 39-3012.00 Gambling and Sports Book Writers and Runners ('Post information enabling patrons to wager on various races').

The official link has no ratings, and O*NET's only 'Patent Engineer' job title sits under 17-2199.06 Microsystems Engineers (MEMS device design), which would misrepresent the job. ESCO describes patent-law advisory work, which O*NET classes under 23-1011.00 Lawyers ('Patent Attorney', 'Patent Solicitor', 'Intellectual Property Lawyer'). The sibling 'intellectual property consultant' already links there.

The only official link is Coaches and Scouts, which misrepresents an administrator of a sports club or federation. Entertainment and Recreation Managers is O*NET's rated management occupation for recreation organisations.

ESCO 1212.5 has no crosswalk row, so the ISCO fallback brought in Online Merchants and Compensation and Benefits Managers. 'Talent Acquisition Manager' and 'Recruiting Manager' are O*NET job titles of Human Resources Managers.
ESCO 2431.17 has no crosswalk row; its ISCO 2431 fallback brings in Online Merchants. Employer branding is marketing work: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists.
Two-thirds of the official weight sits on Switchboard and Telephone Operators. Public Safety Telecommunicators is O*NET's occupation for emergency dispatchers.
